screens.name: editor-never
setup: Action 'prepare: series/programming-languages/episodes/01-typescript-best-practices' (copy to C:\lab\pl01, npm ci), then 'screen-prepare: series/programming-languages/episodes/01-typescript-best-practices/editor-never': VS Code opens C:\lab\pl01 with demo/unsafe.ts at line 31
If the Workspace Trust dialog appears: click 'Yes, I trust the authors'

Optional, the error text is the same with VS Code's own TypeScript: if the notification 'This workspace contains a TypeScript version...' appears, click 'Allow'; otherwise click the '{ }' language status item next to 'TypeScript' in the status bar, click 'Select Version', click 'Use Workspace Version' (6.0.3)
Wait until line 31 shows a red squiggle under 'state' and the status bar error count reads 9 (more if the ESLint extension also reports); move the pointer off the window
steps: Click the errors/warnings indicator at the left of the status bar (circle-x 9, triangle 0): the Problems panel opens with the unsafe.ts errors
Move the pointer onto the word 'state' inside 'assertNever(state)' on line 31 (the red squiggle) and keep it still until the tooltip opens; hold about 5 seconds
Move the pointer off the window; create recordings\stop
After the take: click the window's close button (X) before 'teardown:' removes C:\lab\pl01
